test_title: PYST 26: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Barun starts from Point A and drives 8 km towards West. He then takes a left turn, drives 9 km, turns left and drives 12 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 13 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 4 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only, unless specified.)
solution:
Given:

Barun starts from Point A and drives 8 km towards West.

He then takes a left turn, drives 9 km, turns left and drives 12 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 13 km.

He takes a final left turn, drives 4 km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f961e7c067959bd66657d0b065455e959234ce0847f8ae3cb193e6b9d00f56e5.png] 

Thus, Barun should drive 4 km (13 km - 9 km) in the south direction in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
